t: This is The Hoo, a large detached house in Hampstead. It was built between 1888 and 1890 and altered in 1987 and 1988. It's an early design in the Queen Anne style by the architect Horace Field, and it's Grade II listed. Field was born in London, and his work was often in a Wrenaissance style, with influences from the Arts and Crafts movement and Richard Norman Shaw. He also designed offices for the North Eastern Railway and a number of buildings for Lloyds Bank.
